question: The average weight of 12 people is 65 kg. If one person leaves and the new average becomes 64.5 kg, what is the weight of the person who left?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Weight of the left person = Old Average + (Remaining People × Decrease in Average)

Old Average = 65 kg, Remaining People = 11

Decrease in Average = 65 − 64.5 = 0.5 kg

Weight = 65 + (11 × 0.5)

Weight = 65 + 5.5 = 70.5 kg

**∴ The correct answer is 70.5 kg.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Initial average weight of 12 people = 65 kg

New average weight after 1 person leaves = 64.5 kg

 
 12 People | Average: 65 kg (Total: 780 kg)
 
 
 11 People | Avg: 64.5 kg

 
 1 Left

 

 

 
 Total: 709.5 kg
 ? kg

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total initial weight of 12 people = 12 × 65 = 780 kg

⇒ Total weight of remaining 11 people = 11 × 64.5 = 709.5 kg

⇒ Weight of the person who left = (Total initial weight) − (Total new weight)

⇒ Weight of the person who left = 780 − 709.5

⇒ Weight of the person who left = 70.5 kg

**∴ The correct answer is 70.5 kg.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

When a Person Joins

If a new person joins and the average increases, New Weight = Old Average + (New total people × Increase in average).

When a Person is Replaced

If one person is replaced by another and the average changes, Weight of New Person = Weight of Replaced Person ± (Total number of people × Change in average).

Weighted Average

When combining two groups, Combined Average = (n₁A₁ + n₂A₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂).
